newsitem.title: SPAIN: Two people die in light aircraft crash in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Two people die in light aircraft crash in Spain.

text.p: Two people died when their light aircraft crashed shortly after take-off at the airport in Reus on the eastern coast of Spain, paramilitary Civil Guard officials said on Thursday.
The accident happened just before 17.30 p.m. local time (1630 GMT). Firemen were trying to put out the flames and recover the bodies of the two victims, who have not yet been identified.
